statement.statement_label: The sum of the first n positive odd integers is n squared for every integer n at least zero.

definitions_and_conventions.statement_scope: The variable n ranges over nonnegative integers and the statement concerns the finite sum of the first n positive odd integers.

definitions.term: the first n positive odd integers
definitions.meaning: The sequence 1, 3, 5, ..., 2n-1 when n is positive, and no terms when n is zero.

conventions.label: empty-sum convention
conventions.text: For n equals zero, the sum contains no terms and is defined to be zero.
